note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a MAD 27-29; A06b MAD 27-29; L05 MAD 42-44, 47): ordinary naturalisation after 5 years' residence; no renunciation of other citizenships required; a citizen loses the citizenship on voluntarily taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Madagascar, 2024
sources.said: Person has been habitually resident for 5 years. ... n.a. ... Person voluntarily acquires another citizenship. Person is subject to military service for 15 years after and the loss is subject to authorisation by decree. Or person is a woman who marries a foreigner, lives outside Madagascar, and acquires citizenship of the husband automatically.
